targets.expression: if (Row.genstatus == WRONG) gen_status = new OptionSetValue(WRONG) [WRONG = 4]; else if (!Row.gencalculatescore_IsNull) gen_status = new OptionSetValue(FINISH) [FINISH = 3]. Reachable values of Row.genstatus are 1/2 (source WHERE, match path) or 8 (no-match path, 'Set Status To Wrong'), never 4 - so the WRONG branch is dead and the only value ever written is 3 (FINISH), for every row with a non-NULL gen_calculatescore, INCLUDING unmatched records older than 180 days (status 8 falls into the else branch).
targets.attrCondition: !Row.gencalculatescore_IsNull (effective); written for matched rows and for unmatched >180-day-old rows alike

Rows come from (a) Lookup 'Get Customer Account Details' Match (full cache; keys: gen_precustomeridnumber (zero-padded to 9) = customer account id number zero-padded to 9 AND gen_pregemelaccountnumber (LTRIM/RTRIM in SQL, then PadLeft(12,'0') in 'Add Zeros To Customer Account') = Gen_customeraccount.gen_bankaccountnumber; reference limited to estate type '0149', gen_productsubcustomeraccount in (1,2,4), gen_fundcreationdate > 01/01/2018) or (b) No-Match rows with createdon older than 180 days ('Set Status To No Account' sets gen_status 8, Conditional Split keeps gen_status == 8).
targets.expression: if (Row.genstatus == STATUS_NO_ACCOUNT [8]) gen_status = 8; else if (bankaccountnumber, customeridnumber, genprecustomeridnumber, genpregemelaccountnumber all non-NULL) { if (bankaccountnumber == genpregemelaccountnumber && genprecustomeridnumber == customeridnumber) { ... if (!gencalculatescore_IsNull) gen_status = FINISH [3] } else if (bankaccountnumber == genpregemelaccountnumber && genprecustomeridnumber != customeridnumber) gen_status = WORNG [4] } else gen_status = WORNG [4]. Effective: unmatched rows older than 180 days -> 8; matched rows -> 3 when gen_calculatescore is not NULL (lookup equality makes the key comparison true). 4 is reachable only if a key column is NULL on a matched row (only gen_pregemelaccountnumber can be NULL; whether a NULL key matches a NULL reference value in full-cache mode is SSIS-runtime behaviour - hypothesis).
targets.attrCondition: literal per branch: 8 (no-match, >180 days), 3 (match and gen_calculatescore not NULL), 4 (NULL-key case, see expression); otherwise not set

notes.note: Writers in lineage: 6 script writers. Mapped: 5 gen_meetthecustomer UPDATE writers (4 active, 1 in the disabled task 'Link Meet The Customer To Customer Account By Mini Automated Joining'). Attributes: 3 + 3 + 4 + 2 active = 12, plus 3 in the disabled writer. Excluded as ETL plumbing: End ETL Proccess record\Script Component (gen_etlprocess update), Script Task 'Create ETL Process record', flow 'Get Organization Variables'.

Status-code mismatch (fact from DTSX; business impact = hypothesis): in 'Link Pre Meet The Customer To Customer Program' and 'Link Meet The Customer To Customer Account By Automated Joining' the no-match branch sets gen_status = 8 for records older than 180 days, but the writers test for 4 (WRONG). Those rows therefore fall into the else branch: no lookup values, and gen_status is set to 3 (FINISH) whenever gen_calculatescore is not NULL; otherwise an update with no attributes is sent. The other two active flows (Customer Account, Pre Account Number) test for 8 and write 8.

Every row added to the batch is sent as an Update even if no attribute was set (Entity with only Id), e.g. Customer Program / Automated Joining rows with NULL lookup values and NULL gen_calculatescore.

Order (precedence): Customer Program -> Customer Account -> Automated Joining -> (Mini, disabled) -> Pre Account Number. Later flows re-read gen_meetthecustomer, so records updated earlier (gen_gemelaccountnumber set or status changed to 3/4/8) drop out of later sources by their WHERE clauses.

Pre Account Number lookup compares raw gen_pregemelaccountnumber with the customer account bank number whose leading zeros are stripped; a pre number that itself has leading zeros or spaces will not match (fact: SQL DTSX:6067-6079 vs source DTSX:6008-6021 without trimming).

Error handling: SoapException/Exception rows go to CastingError (no path connected in Customer Program/Customer Account/Automated Joining flows - output unconnected) ; ExecuteMultiple faults are added to the async Error output, which is also unconnected. Failed updates are therefore not logged (fact for paths; runtime behaviour of the proxy unknown).

Customer Account flow: input columns gen_producttype, productsubcustomeraccount, estatetype, estatetypename, fundcreationdate are passed to the writer but never used in its code. Automated Joining writer: CreatedOn and meetTheCustomerAutomatedJoiningId unused. Pre Account Number writer: CreatedOn, gen_preaccountnumber, gen_gemelaccountnumber, gen_pregemelaccountnumber unused.
